stations.title: Hesper
stations.say: What can it do? Show me.

stations.title: The shop's work
stations.text: Count, list and check, with no way in.

captions: Idris is out, and Hesper wants to see what orders can do without reading code.
The shop's work is all written, but the tool cannot run it or say what it is.
You write a table of commands, help written from it, and the nearest command.
Now Sefton's typo gets an answer, and --help always says what the tool does.
Same tool, three commands, and help that cannot go stale.
